description: This file defines a Java interface for building JSON field selectors using a fluent API. It specifies methods for adding, removing, and constructing JSON pointers and field selectors, facilitating complex JSON query construction.

classes.name: JsonFieldSelectorBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder interface for creating complex JsonFieldSelector instances with a fluent API, enabling addition and removal of JSON pointers and field definitions.

methods.name: addPointer
methods.description: Adds one or more JSON pointers to the selector being built.

methods.name: addPointers
methods.description: Adds multiple JSON pointers from an iterable collection.

methods.name: addPointerString
methods.description: Adds one or more JSON pointers represented as strings.

methods.name: addPointerStrings
methods.description: Adds multiple JSON pointers as strings from an iterable collection.

methods.name: addFieldDefinition
methods.description: Adds JSON pointers based on provided JSON field definitions.

methods.name: addFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Adds multiple field definitions to the selector.

methods.name: addFieldSelector
methods.description: Includes all pointers from another JsonFieldSelector.

methods.name: addFieldSelectorString
methods.description: Adds JSON pointers parsed from a field selector string with options.

methods.name: addFieldSelectorString
methods.description: Adds JSON pointers parsed from a field selector string without options.

methods.name: removePointerString
methods.description: Removes a JSON pointer identified by its string.

methods.name: removePointerStrings
methods.description: Removes multiple JSON pointers specified as strings.

methods.name: removeFieldDefinition
methods.description: Removes a field pointer based on a field definition.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates an immutable JsonFieldSelector instance containing all added pointers.
